subject: Early Implementation of a TreeGrid widget

messages.author: 4607d18cb6bf89f0
messages.subject: Early Implementation of a TreeGrid widget
parts:
Hi all,

I would like to share this early implementation of a TreeGrid widget, which provides a way to display hierarchical data.

You can try it out with:
library(shiny)
runGitHub(repo='Shiny-sandbox','cafe876', ref="master", subdir="shiny-treegrid")

The widget comes from the jQuery EasyUI library, which has a many additional features that I didn't implement yet, like drag-and-drop, on-the-fly edition, and checkboxes.

I believe that this kind of widget has an important place in an analytic process, both to analyze and to edit data structures.

Currently, the most painful for me is the data input format. 
Have a look at the transformation that was needed for the demo dataset...it is horrible.
In the end it is just a list of lists that will be converted to JSON, but I'm not used to these manipulations.
Therefore: any suggestions welcome !

Best,
NH
